title: Card Payments Clause: Amount of a Card Catch-Up Charge on a Storage Unit Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Clause.** On a storage unit agreement drafted by card under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the declined due date is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date. The card catch-up charge is the rent charge of the declined due date, which is the contracted monthly rent less the unit class's military discount rate where the military discount is applied, rounded to the cent. The card catch-up charge is never below zero and is rounded to the cent once.

**Input, judgement, output.**

1. *Input:* the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement's oldest unpaid due date (the date it has been delinquent since), its contracted monthly rent, whether the military discount is applied, and its unit class's military discount rate.
2. *Judgement:* is the military discount applied on the agreement?
3. *Output:* if yes, the contracted monthly rent times one minus the military discount rate, rounded to the cent; if no, the contracted monthly rent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs).**

| Contracted monthly rent | Military discount applied | Rate | Card catch-up charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| $95.00 | No | — | $95.00 |
| $95.00 | Yes | 10% | $85.50 |
| $212.40 | Yes | 10% | $191.16 |

The declined due date for an agreement delinquent since 12 June, with the 12 July period also unpaid, is 12 June (hypothetical dates).
